topic: Evidence-grounded personal research agent with expert collaboration, controlled execution, context compaction and durable recovery

selected_approach.name: Project-specific component evaluation following DeerFlow 2.0
principles: Fixed local inputs with hidden expected answers
Fresh paired runs changing one factor
Independent checks of saved final artifacts
Separate artifact correctness and clean execution
Include failed runs and incomplete usage in reporting
Blind human semantic review before calibrated automated judging
selected_approach.candidate_arm: Not yet selected; establish baseline first and rerun both arms when a concrete candidate exists.
selected_approach.scope: Expert component first; main-chat multi-expert end-to-end tests are a separate later suite. Eight development cases do not establish general benchmark performance.
selected_approach.implemented_ab_factor: expert_synthesize method instructions only; isolated database per arm/trial

validation.first_smoke_grader_false_negatives: Q02 equivalent entity labels; original frozen batch retained, aliases corrected for new batches

reference_implementations.name: DeerFlow 2.0 context snapshot benchmark
reference_implementations.observed_method: Eight synthetic tasks, paired handoff variants, public and hidden artifact checks, artifact correctness separate from clean success, accounting for parent and worker usage.
reference_implementations.adaptation: Adopt evaluation boundaries and artifact-first reporting; use this project's sources, result schema, controlled ledger and semantic requirements.
reference_implementations.limitation: A component benchmark, not full product or general research capability evaluation; JSON/Python checks do not replace semantic review of research prose.

reference_implementations.name: DeerFlow 2.0 memory eviction benchmark
reference_implementations.observed_method: Fixed LongMemEval subset plus synthetic correction cases, paired eviction policies, separate support-retention and answer scoring, blind deterministic grading and paired statistics.
reference_implementations.adaptation: Borrow fixed inputs, blinded grading and explicit subset boundaries; memory eviction itself is outside the initial project suite.
reference_implementations.limitation: Neither a full official LongMemEval result nor full memory extraction and application evaluation.

search_plan_record.note: Retrospective record of the search scope; not an experiment preregistration.
search_plan_record.selection: Prioritize original papers, author repositories and official docs; inspect current implementation where original paper and current evaluator differ.

project_evidence.finding: Current controlled research/expert product uses PostgreSQL and SDK Runner.
Three synthetic quality cases and historical contract/live evidence; limited generalization explicitly acknowledged.
Successful execution with unresolved semantic errors in arithmetic explanation, limitations and behavioral history.
Semantic review remains pending in programmatic summary.

Evaluation registration binds to committed task results.
Before arm must use the historical case result.

benchmarks.task: Long-form research reports evaluated against expert-derived requirements
benchmarks.protocol: 132 tasks, 9430 rubrics. Original paper uses binary rubric satisfaction; pin current official evaluator separately.
benchmarks.evidence: Paper sections 3.1.2 and 4.1 define per-rubric scoring; official README and aggregate_scores.py document current evaluator and blocked-reference scoring.
benchmarks.current_version_note: Official main now uses GPT-5.5; paper used Gemini-2.5-Pro. No score comparison across judge revisions without re-evaluation.
benchmarks.limitations: Does not evaluate project-specific authorization, persistence or manager/expert lifecycle. Current data license is per task.

benchmarks.task: Multi-step open-web search and exhaustive answer sets
benchmarks.protocol: 900 prompts across 17 domains; metrics computed per question and then averaged. Keep answer and answer_type hidden from agent.
benchmarks.evidence: Paper section 3 evaluation metrics; official dataset card Dataset Description and Evaluation Prompt.
benchmarks.current_version_note: Data card specifies gemini-2.5-flash and linked starter grading prompt; changing either changes comparability.
benchmarks.limitations: English dataset, live-web drift, final-answer grading does not establish process efficiency or citation validity.

benchmarks.task: Open research reports including Chinese tasks
benchmarks.protocol: 100 tasks, 50 Chinese and 50 English; report export and separate grading.
benchmarks.evidence: Official README Benchmark Construction and Evaluation Framework; Open Deep Research README evaluation integration.
benchmarks.limitations: Pin cleaner and judges; report-level scores and supported-citation counts are not sufficient release criteria.

benchmarks.task: Research over a fixed curated corpus, separating retriever and agent effects
benchmarks.protocol: Fixed approximately 100K document corpus; use official scoring if integrated.
benchmarks.evidence: Official README introduction and dataset/index setup.
benchmarks.limitations: Scoring implementation not audited in this survey; corpus/index integration is more work than initial project fixtures.

benchmarks.task: Prompt-injection robustness while preserving useful task completion
benchmarks.protocol: Borrow paired clean/attacked task design for project tools; adapted suite is not the official benchmark.
benchmarks.limitations: Official task domains do not directly represent this research workspace.

benchmarks.task: Unambiguous-answer general assistant tasks with varying tool needs and optional attachments
benchmarks.protocol: Use official protocol and disclose supported-capability subset; validation and hidden-answer test sets are distinct.
benchmarks.evidence: Official dataset README Data and leaderboard, gating metadata and Dataset Format update.
benchmarks.limitations: Gated data; no dataset downloaded; not a direct evaluation of long-form synthesis or expert handoff.

limitations: External benchmarks listed here were researched only; no external benchmark scores or leaderboard submissions were produced.
Live trials use only local synthetic evaluation fixtures and the configured DeepSeek endpoint. They are smoke checks, not the proposed 24/48-trial formal batches.
Official reference URLs are mutable; executed local cases, rules, code hashes, model and dependency versions are frozen per batch.
The eight development cases and evaluation implementation do not establish full product or open-web research capability.
Semantic review remains pending; model completion and passing deterministic checks are not final quality scores.
